title: Relay Commons
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: A calm first-person exploration and base-building RPG prototype in real mapped streets. Bayfield waterfront default, town/address starts, category-based shops, homes, civic entrances and inhabited street details. Discover places, gather shared wood/stone/cloth, build shelter/hearth/workbench/storage/lighting with placement preview and safe street/footprint exclusion. Shared camp, exploration XP, journal routes, pinch/pan atlas, portable exact-map saves and up to four P2P explorers. Holstered weapons; optional 160m ranged sparring, no attacking bots or timed score race. Uses only warehouse parts, original code/art CC0, OSM data ODbL. Inferred facades, no interiors or elevation; host must stay active.
